summary: Approve exact two-file candidate (combined patch SHA256 4e7017eca9dfe9e23e1e957e808047c8652633e108a78bf91f7e2c5cd1318b4b against base 9a140f7eb7844ca2b952d8f4142a5cd7fd820dbb) for scoped source-only starter CLI resolution. In crates/mori/src/commands/init.rs:106-111, run() resolves std::env::current_exe(), enforces UTF-8 via to_str() without lossy substitution, and single-quotes the path as one POSIX shell word before std::fs::create_dir(&args.dir) (line 114), preventing partial destination creation on error and avoiding PATH collision with the TypeScript mori CLI. POSIX single-quoting ('...' with ' -> '\'') neutralizes shell metacharacters, spaces, quotes, and expansions; args.dir is never interpolated into README.md, and action is a closed match ("pay"|"repay", lines 52-55). In crates/mori/tests/init.rs:325-380, the Unix regression copies the binary into "Rust CLI's tools 🧪" and runs the extracted README.md sh block via /bin/sh with PATH="" across check, simulate, and test consumers. Source approval covers only local moriarty/1 and moriarty-core/1 starter behavior; it is not runtime pass evidence, independent financial oracle verification, or native execution admission.
